paras: Application: Toyota GR86 and Subaru BRZ (2022+) Part Type: Dual (PCV + CCV) Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0913-FL

The Radium 20-0913-FL combines the PCV kit (20-0911-FL) and CCV kit (20-0902-FL) for the 2022+ GR86 and BRZ, and is Radium's recommendation for maximum engine protection. The PCV can runs inline with the 5/8in PCV valve hose on the RH side of the engine bay; the CCV can runs inline with the 1/2in breather port on the LH side.
hl: Dual Kit: PCV and CCV circuits covered in one kit
Fluid Lock: Patented Fluid Lock design stops the reservoir overfilling and traps collected fluid until the can is emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick to check the fluid level
ft: Radium Engineering Dual Fluid Lock Catch Can Kit for Subaru BRZ ZD8 / Toyota GR86 ZN8 2022+
